title: Weapon rule definition
description: Defines a universal weapon rule and the kind of parameter it takes. Team-local rules are ability records with kind weaponRule.

param.description: none = bare rule; inches = Range, Blast, Torrent x in inches; count = Piercing, Devastating, Accurate, Limited x; target = Lethal x+.

critsVariant.description: True when the rule has a Crits variant (Piercing Crits x).

distanceVariant.description: True when the rule accepts a distance prefix (Devastating with a distance).

moveRestriction.description: True when the rule may name the only move allowed (Heavy, Dash only).

ref.description: Rule id in docs/spec/10-rules-core.md, for example R-10.12.
